notes.title: Marks on map
notes.content:
While you are making your way through the country, pay attention to static and dynamic marks on the map. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28341243/7091eec491f1ab0fad506ef4fe61fa7fcd4b48fb.png[/img]

Static marks may point at resources or trade markets. Dynamic marks show other groups, both friendly and aggressive. 

You'll never know what's behind a dynamics mark so think twice before you decide to approach and make contact.

notes.title: Various team combinations
notes.content:
Every time you start a new game you can choose five different teammates, according to their abilities and perks. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28341243/9c68215d3db827cc11b0028ac0a572bc9caed81f.png[/img]

Combine characters differently to make sure your group is a useful mix of skillful survivors!

notes.title: Communication style
notes.content:
As you move forward, you'll meet various characters - both friendly and hostile. 
Choose from given communication options and build profitable relations with strangers and traders.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28341243/a4932a8e8c2b536fe8b06619359a04df74d74e27.png[/img]

But beware of the gangs that will want all your staff and even your life! Decide carefully on whether or not to take up the ball!

notes.title: Destinations
notes.content:
On your way to escape the war, you can choose between three destination points: Port, Airport or Immigration Center. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28341243/be294495837d63624e7d57df766c1c5d8f29d209.png[/img]

Which way is the safest and the easiest? It heavily depends on your team. And on your luck as well!

notes.title: Displaced: Narrative Survival
notes.content:
Lead a group of civilians through the war-struck country and help them survive!

Presented in a form of a narration with dialogues and descriptions, the game allows you to thoroughly consider the next steps.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28341243/bcee0a15c2178ab56b61b2b20e0668a00865c58a.jpg[/img]
